confidence: Moderate for a short list, low for an individual. Three direct glass-related actions now outweigh motive-only suspicions.
plausibility_notes: Brie is explicitly distinct from the service manager; this corrects the earlier role inference and keeps glass custody understandable.
Al touching the glass, Dada juxtaposing a prop, and Brie cleaning it are meaningful physical opportunities, not just stylistic clues.
Twenty-two simultaneous confrontations in one delay feel highly compressed and choreographed; the dinner convention can carry it but literal realism strains.
Repeated admission-plus-donor-pressure-plus-public-correction structure makes the confessions mechanically similar.
Brie cleaning a spill is natural service behavior; Al mock-toasting and Dada demonstrating collapse are more theatrical but role-consistent.
No confession proves truth; direct handling needs material corroboration.
